2. Privacy Policy

2.1 Data we collect. HappyMoments is designed with privacy at its core. The App operates entirely in your browser and does not transmit personal data to any server unless you explicitly choose to (e.g., sharing via WhatsApp, or using the gift store checkout).

Data stored locally on your device includes:

  • Names and dates you enter (birthdays, anniversaries, etc.)
  • Your settings and preferences (lucky digits, patterns, dark mode)
  • Group/set configurations

2.2 Where data is stored. Your milestone data (names, dates, settings) is stored locally in your browser's localStorage on your device, encrypted with AES-GCM. We do not have access to this data unless you choose to create an account.

2.3 Optional account and authentication. You may optionally sign in using Google, Apple, or email/password via Firebase Authentication (operated by Google). When you sign in:

  • Your email address and display name are stored in our database (Cloudflare D1) to manage your account and premium status
  • Firebase Authentication processes your sign-in credentials according to Google's Privacy Policy
  • You can delete your account and all associated data at any time from Settings

2.4 Anonymous usage analytics. We collect anonymous, cookie-free usage analytics to improve the app:

  • Events tracked: page views, feature usage, sharing actions (no personal content is sent)
  • Session-based with random session IDs (not linked to your identity unless signed in)
  • Country-level location via Cloudflare headers (no IP addresses stored)
  • Respects Do Not Track (DNT) browser setting — if enabled, no analytics are collected
  • No cookies, no Google Analytics, no Facebook Pixel, no advertising identifiers

Legal basis: we process anonymous analytics under legitimate interest (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)) to improve the App. Because the data is cookie-free, non-identifying, and honours Do Not Track, we consider this proportionate. You can disable it by enabling Do Not Track in your browser.

2.5 Third-party services. When you use share or calendar features, data is sent to the respective service (WhatsApp, Google Calendar, Outlook, etc.) according to their privacy policies. We have no control over how these services handle the shared content.

2.6 Gift store. If and when the gift store becomes active, placing an order will require sharing personal information (name, shipping address, payment details) with our payment processor (Stripe) and fulfillment partners. This data will be processed solely for order fulfillment and will be governed by Stripe's privacy policy and our partners' privacy policies. We will clearly inform you before any such data is collected.

2.7 Your rights (GDPR / CCPA). Since your data is stored locally on your device, you have full control:

  • Access & portability: Use Export Data (Settings > Backup) to download everything you've entered as a JSON file
  • Restore: Use Import Data to load a previous export
  • Erasure — account: Use Delete Account (Settings) to remove your account and the associated server-side record
  • Erasure — local data: Clear your browser's site data for happymoments.app to remove all locally stored milestones and settings

2.8 Children's privacy. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 15 through account sign-up. Core milestone data is stored locally on the device and not transmitted. If you believe a child under 15 has created an account, contact us and we will delete it.

2.9 Data retention. Your milestone data persists in your browser until you delete it or clear your browser data; we keep no server-side copy of it. If you create an account, the associated record (email, display name, premium status) is retained until you delete your account.

3. Disclaimer

3.1 No warranty. The App is provided "AS IS" and "AS AVAILABLE" without warranties of any kind, either express or implied, including but not limited to implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, or non-infringement.

3.2 Accuracy. While we strive for accuracy in milestone calculations (dates, times, special number classifications), we do not guarantee that all calculations are error-free. Milestone dates are calculated assuming a birth time of midnight (00:00) on the date entered. Actual milestone moments may differ by up to 24 hours depending on your exact time of birth. Dates may also vary slightly due to time zone differences, leap year handling, or calendar system variations. Months and years use calendar-accurate arithmetic; seconds, minutes, hours, days, and weeks use exact elapsed time. Do not rely on the App for time-critical decisions.

3.6 Indemnification. You agree to indemnify and hold harmless the developers of HappyMoments from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from your use of the App or violation of these Terms.

4. Cookie & Storage Notice

HappyMoments uses browser localStorage (not cookies) to save your dates, settings, and preferences. This data never leaves your device unless you explicitly share or export it. By using the App, you consent to this local storage. You can remove all locally stored data at any time by clearing your browser's site data for happymoments.app.
